<module id="radix2_div">
    <description>Implements a simplified radix-2 divider for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates if the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input signal representing the divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit input signal indicating that a valid operation request is present.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating that the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State IDLE = 3'd0;</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIVIDE">State DIVIDE = 3'd1;</parameter>
        <parameter id="DONE">State DONE = 3'd2;</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="neg_divisor" width_description="[8:0]">The negative value of the divisor.</signal>
        <signal id="sr" width_description="[9:0]">Shift register for storing the dividend during division.</signal>
        <signal id="sub_result" width_description="[8:0]">The result of subtracting the divisor from the current shift register.</signal>
        <signal id="carry_out">The carry-out from the subtraction operation.</signal>
        <signal id="mux_out" width_description="[8:0]">The selected result between the subtraction and the previous shift register.</signal>
        <signal id="cnt">The counter for keeping track of the number of iterations.</signal>
        <signal id="start_cnt">Start counter flag.</signal>
        <signal id="temp_res" width_description="[15:0]">Temporary result storage.</signal>
        <signal id="abs_dividend" width_description="[7:0]">Absolute value of the dividend.</signal>
        <signal id="abs_divisor" width_description="[7:0]">Absolute value of the divisor.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the rising edge of the clock or reset
        always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
            if (rst) begin
                // Reset all registers and flags to their initial values
                abs_dividend <= 8'h0;
                abs_divisor <= 8'h0;
                sr <= 10'h0;
                neg_divisor <= 9'h0;
                cnt <= 4'h0;
                start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                temp_res <= 16'h0;
                res_valid <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                // Check if there's a valid operation request and the result isn't already valid
                if ((opn_valid == 1'b1) && (res_valid == 1'b0)) begin
                    // Save the dividend and divisor for processing
                    abs_dividend <= (sign & dividend[7]) ? (~dividend + 1'b1) : dividend;
                    abs_divisor <= (sign & divisor[7]) ? (~divisor + 1'b1) : divisor;
                    
                    // Initialize the shift register with the absolute value of the dividend
                    sr <= {1'b0, abs_dividend} << 1;
                    // Calculate the negative divisor for subtraction
                    neg_divisor <= ~{1'b0, abs_divisor} + 1'b1;
                    // Set the counter and start counter flag
                    cnt <= 4'h1;
                    start_cnt <= 1'b1;
                end else if (start_cnt) begin
                    // Check if the most significant bit of the counter is set
                    if (cnt[3]) begin
                        // Clear the start counter flag and counter
                        start_cnt <= 1'b0;
                        cnt <= 4'h0;
                        
                        // Update the temporary result with the remainder and quotient
                        temp_res <= {sr[8:0], 8'h0};
                        // Set the result valid flag
                        res_valid <= 1'b1;
                    end else begin
                        // Increment the counter
                        cnt <= cnt + 1'b1;
                        // Perform subtraction and update the shift register
                        {carry_out, sub_result} <= {1'b0, sr} + neg_divisor;
                        mux_out <= (carry_out) ? sub_result : {sr[8:0], 1'b0};
                        sr <= mux_out;
                    end
                end
                
                // Manage the result validity flag based on reset, counter, and consumption status
                if (rst || (cnt != 4'h0) || !res_valid) begin
                    res_valid <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assign the result output to the temporary result
        assign result = temp_res;
        
        // Assign the remainder output to the upper 8 bits of the temporary result
        assign remainder = temp_res[15:8];
        
        // Assign the quotient output to the lower 8 bits of the temporary result
        assign quotient = temp_res[7:0];
    </implementation>
    
    <!-- Task definition for calculating the remainder -->
    task calculate_remainder(input [15:0] result);
        begin
            // Extract the remainder from the result
            remainder = result[15:8];
        end
    endtask
    
    <!-- Task definition for calculating the quotient -->
    task calculate_quotient(input [15:0] result);
        begin
            // Extract the quotient from the result
            quotient = result[7:0];
        end
    endtask
</module>
